theorems.name: Submission.regcomp_covector_sq_sum_orthonormalBasis
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n) (f : OrthonormalBasis (Fin P) ℝ (Euclid P)), ∑ j : Fin n → Fin P, (α (fun k => f (j k))) ^ 2 = (n.factorial : ℝ) * covectorEuclideanNorm α ^ 2
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
